To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a distributed simulation environment based on a SE approach is a promising approach to design and develop innovative distributed control systems and to study their impact on building performance applications.

the developed middleware can be used as a framework to couple multiple software tools in a distributed simulation environment, and that it is possible to couple building performance simulation and control simulation environments using the proposed SE methodology and the developed middleware.

a) The developed framework allows the integration of different simulation tools and control environments over a network in a distributed manner; and b) The framework allows the integration and simulation of control systems and building performance applications, such as HVAC, lighting, and other control systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a framework that allows for the integration of multiple simulation tools and control systems over a network.

the design and implementation of a middleware for the distributed control and building simulations that has been developed to study and analyze building indoor environments over a network rather than costly and long-term experiments.
the design and implementation of an integrated framework to simulate the performance of a building and its control system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the framework has been designed and developed to support distributed control and building simulations over a network and it can be used for the design of ABs.
the proposed framework has been successfully used for the design of a distributed simulation for control and building performance simulation applications over a network.
the proposed SE methodology for distributed control and simulation is an efficient and effective tool for the development of distributed control systems for buildings.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed framework is a novel approach to the design and development a middleware for distributed building performance simulations and control modelling over a network.
the framework provides an integrated environment for distributed building performance simulations and control applications.

this paper provides a framework for the development and design of a middleware for the integration of distributed control and simulation applications over a network, which is based on the SE methodology.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the developed framework allows the user to easily couple multiple simulation tools over a network, to design and simulate the impact of innovative control systems, to analyze the performance of the building, and to compare different control systems and their effects on building performance.
a distributed simulation environment based on SE methodology can be used for the design, development and evaluation of innovative distributed BACSs.
the developed framework is capable of simulating the impact of distributed control systems on the building performance over a network.
